notes.zh-CN: 修两处导航条问题：点某个刻度后高亮会退回上一条（跳转落点比判定阈值低 4px），现在停在点的那一条；悬停卡片的宽度被 14px 的导航条挤成一个字一行，改成固定 15rem，正常换行。当前刻度的颜色也加深，和悬停区分开。
notes.en: Two rail fixes: after clicking a tick the highlight fell back to the message above (the jump lands 4px below the threshold the scroll check used) — it now stays on the one you clicked. The hover card was squeezed by the 14px-wide rail into one character per line; it has a fixed 15rem width now and wraps normally. The current tick is also darker so it reads apart from hover.
